name: Orichalcum
notes: Weapon: +1 speed, accuracy and defense when wielded by a Solar. Armor: +2 to both lethal and bashing soak when worn by a Solar (core p.341, p.345).

name: Moonsilver
notes: Weapon: +2 accuracy in the hands of a Lunar; can change shape. Armor: no mobility penalty no matter how heavy, when worn by a Lunar (core p.341, p.345).

name: Jade
notes: Weapon: +3 speed in the hands of a Dragon-Blooded. Armor: no fatigue value when worn by a Terrestrial (core p.341, p.345).

name: Starmetal
notes: Weapon: +2 damage in the hands of a Sidereal. Armor: normal soak, but subtracts 1 from the attacker's damage successes (can reduce a blow to 0) when worn by a Sidereal — a damage-roll effect, applied at combat resolution, not a soak delta (core p.341, p.346).

name: Soulsteel
notes: Weapon: +1 accuracy in the hands of an Abyssal and drains motes of Essence equal to the wielder's permanent Essence on any strike dealing at least one health level. Armor: +2 to all soaks when worn by an Abyssal (core p.341, p.346).
